subject.title: feat(models): add provider request.timeoutMs and retry configuration

question: Should this PR expose provider retry configuration now, or split retry back to the canonical retry issue and only pursue the timeoutMs change here?
rationale: The retry schema is a new public config contract with no runtime behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent provider retry API semantics or fallback ordering.

options.title: Split retry out
options.body: Remove retry schema/help/labels/types from this PR and keep retry design on the canonical retry issue while repairing and proving the timeoutMs path.

options.title: Implement retry fully
options.body: Keep the retry surface only if this PR wires model-call retry behavior, error classification, fallback ordering, tests, docs, and proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Close or pause this combined branch if maintainers want a broader retry/API design before accepting any new provider config surface.

recommendation.title: Split retry out
recommendation.body: Remove retry schema/help/labels/types from this PR and keep retry design on the canonical retry issue while repairing and proving the timeoutMs path.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the primary maintainer and the strongest visible owner for deciding whether this new config surface belongs in core now.
